statement: Discrete Invariants from V4: under the V4 action the total count N = n_O + n_C + n_N + n_L is invariant, and the charge Q = n_O - n_L + n_C - n_N satisfies s(Q) = Q, n(Q) = -Q, so Q^2 is invariant.
